purpose: Empirical software demonstration, not a clinically validated BBB predictor
license: CC0-1.0, verified upstream README and LICENSE
curation: Use all provided categorical groups. Map BBB+ to 1 and BBB- to 0. Reject missing/invalid/zero-atom SMILES and labels; remove ALL conflicting canonical-label records; collapse exact canonical duplicates. No salt stripping, tautomer merging or outcome-based exclusions.
internal_holdout: One scaffold GroupShuffleSplit; test_size=0.25, seed=2026. Do not retry seed. Acyclic structures grouped by canonical molecule; analogous acyclic compounds can remain chemically related across partitions.
models: ATHENA RF, existing 100 trees and balanced class weighting
external_filter: Remove all external canonical structures OR Murcko/canonical scaffold groups overlapping the entire development corpus, including the internal holdout. Do not weaken this filter if the retained set is small or one class disappears.
metrics: ROC AUC when both classes exist
uncertainty: 2000 paired scaffold-cluster bootstrap draws, seed=8841. All models share each draw; one-class draws omitted only for metrics requiring both classes, with counts reported. Fixed fitted models, conditional test-set uncertainty; no refitting.
sensitivity: Leave-one-scaffold-out influence on balanced accuracy. Report full external class counts, retained fraction and descriptor-range flags.
decision: No performance threshold gates inclusion. Null, weak, baseline-dominated and one-class outcomes are retained. If external ROC is not estimable, say so and report why. No claim of prospective validation on data not yet existing; this is a frozen analysis of previously public data.
